title: Proof of Delivery Checklist
subtitle: Proof Of Delivery: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Proof of Delivery Checklist covers delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof. The delivery verification coordinator records Proof Of Delivery criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Proof of Delivery Checklist keeps Proof Of Delivery exceptions visible until the delivery verification coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Proof of Delivery Checklist at destination address, authorized delivery point, vehicle, and custody handoff. Document delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof identity before Proof Of Delivery begins. Compare delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof findings with stated Proof Of Delivery criteria; route unresolved Proof Of Delivery issues to delivery evidence reviewer.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Proof Of Delivery, identify responsible parties, destination address, authorized delivery point, vehicle, and custody handoff, and the linked delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof source.

fields.label: Piece, package, serial, seal, and quantity
Recipient, organization, authority, and delivery-point identity

sections.title: Checklist points, conditions, and actions
sections.guidance: Capture Proof Of Delivery facts for delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Proof Of Delivery inspection checks
items: Signature, photograph, scan, or other permitted proof
Refusal, unattended delivery, or failed-attempt basis

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

sections.title: Inspection exception, restriction, and reinspection
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Proof Of Delivery finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Delivery Verification Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Proof collection would exceed privacy policy
blocks.guidance: Pause Proof Of Delivery when recipient, location, custody, condition, or permitted proof remains unresolved. Retain the available Proof Of Delivery proof and route unresolved delivered unit, recipient, delivery point, timestamp, condition, and privacy-conscious proof scope to delivery verification coordinator.
